WITH per_event AS (
    SELECT link_to_event AS event_id, COUNT(*) AS attendance_count
    FROM attendance
    GROUP BY link_to_event
), shares AS (
    SELECT event_id,
           attendance_count,
           1.0 * attendance_count / NULLIF(SUM(attendance_count) OVER (), 0) AS share
    FROM per_event
), ranked AS (
    SELECT event_id,
           attendance_count,
           share,
           RANK() OVER (ORDER BY share DESC) AS share_rank
    FROM shares
)
SELECT event_id, attendance_count, share
FROM ranked
WHERE share_rank <= 10
ORDER BY share DESC NULLS LAST;

assumptions.assumption: “Keep the first 10 rows plus any further events whose share ties with the 10th one” means include all rows tied at the 10th position, using rank by share.
